title: UNDERSTANDING AND MITIGATING RISKS OF GENERATIVE AI IN FINANCIAL SERVICES
findings: The paper identifies religion as a potential risk factor within its proposed AI content safety taxonomy for financial services, specifically under the categories of 'Discrimination' (via religious animus) and 'Personally Identifiable Information' (via religious affiliation). However, the evaluation dataset had very few examples for the discrimination category, and no specific performance metrics or findings related to religion are reported.
